titleEn: Townhouse Renovation Surrey BC 2026: Real Costs, Permits & Complete Guide
titleZh: 素里鎮屋裝修 2026：真實費用、許可證與完整指南
excerptEn: Surrey townhouse renovation costs $25,000–$150,000+ in 2026. This guide covers Strata approval, BC Building Code requirements, real project costs, and neighbourhood-specific permit rules for Clayton, Cloverdale, Fleetwood, and Guildford townhouses.
excerptZh: 素里鎮屋裝修費用為 $25,000 至 $150,000+。本指南涵蓋 Strata 審批、BC 建築規範要求，真實工程費用，以及 Clayton、Cloverdale、Fleetwood 和 Guildford 鎮屋的特定許可證規則。
contentEn:
Surrey townhouse renovation in 2026 costs $25,000 to $150,000 or more depending on scope, age of the complex, and whether you are renovating for personal use or to prepare for sale. Unlike detached homes, every townhouse renovation in Surrey requires Strata Council approval and compliance with BC Building Code requirements — a process that adds two to eight weeks to project timelines. This guide uses real project data from Reno Stars and the City of Surrey's building permit records to give Surrey homeowners accurate cost expectations for 2026.

How Much Does a Townhouse Renovation Cost in Surrey in 2026?

Surrey townhouse renovation costs fall into three tiers based on scope. A cosmetic refresh — new paint, flooring, lighting fixtures and cabinet hardware — typically runs $15,000 to $35,000. A functional renovation that includes kitchen or bathroom updates, updated plumbing fixtures and new countertops usually costs $40,000 to $85,000. A full gut renovation that involves moving walls, rewiring, replumbing and upgrading structural elements can reach $100,000 to $150,000 or more, particularly in townhouse complexes built before 2000 where building envelope issues are common.

The age of the townhouse complex is the single biggest cost variable. Surrey townhouses built in the 1980s and 1990s — common in Cloverdale, Fleetwood and Guildford — frequently require poly-B piping replacement, outdated electrical panels upgrades, and building envelope remediation before cosmetic work can begin. Reno Stars has completed over 40 townhouse renovation projects across Surrey since 2018, with project costs ranging from $22,000 for a single-bathroom refresh to $138,000 for a full two-storey townhouse gut renovation in Clayton.

Surrey Strata Approval Process for Townhouse Renovations

Every townhouse in Surrey falls under the Strata Property Act (British Columbia), which means your renovation plans must be approved by your Strata Council before any work begins. The approval process typically requires submitting a renovation application with detailed drawings, contractor information and scope of work description. Most Strata Councils require two to four weeks to review applications, and some impose restrictions on noise hours, contractor access and the types of materials allowed in common areas.

Reno Stars has navigated Strata approval processes across more than a dozen Surrey townhouse complexes, including buildings managed by Crossroads Strata Management, Bentley Strata Services and Baywest Property Management. We prepare all required documentation as part of our standard project process and coordinate directly with Strata Councils on behalf of homeowners. Budget an additional $500 to $1,500 in permit and application fees on top of your construction costs.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Surrey Neighbourhood Guide: Townhouse Renovation by Area

Surrey's townhouse stock varies significantly by neighbourhood, which directly affects renovation scope and cost. Clayton and Willoughby — the newest areas — feature townhouses built between 2010 and 2022 with modern layouts, larger square footage and fewer underlying issues. Renovations in these areas tend to focus on aesthetic upgrades rather than structural remediation, with typical project costs of $35,000 to $95,000 for kitchen or bathroom renovations.

Fleetwood and Guildford contain the largest concentration of 1980s and 1990s townhouse complexes in Surrey. These units often have dated kitchen layouts, original bathrooms and infrastructure that requires updating before cosmetic work. A full kitchen renovation in a Guildford townhouse built in 1992, for example, typically requires not just new cabinets and countertops but also electrical panel upgrades to handle modern appliances — adding $3,000 to $8,000 to the project cost.

Cloverdale townhouses tend to fall between these two extremes. The neighbourhood's heritage character extends to townhouse complexes from the 1970s through 2000s, with a mix of owner-occupied and rental strata buildings. Strata approval in Cloverdale can move faster in owner-occupied complexes where neighbours know each other, but rental-heavy buildings may require more formal documentation and longer review periods.

  • Clayton/Willoughby: Newer builds (2010-2022), fewer structural issues, $35K-$95K typical kitchen/bath renovation
  • Fleetwood/Guildford: 1980s-1990s stock, often requires electrical or piping remediation, $45K-$120K full renovation
  • Cloverdale: Mixed age (1970s-2000s), owner-occupied complexes approve faster, $30K-$90K typical project

Do You Need a Building Permit for Townhouse Renovation in Surrey?

Surrey requires building permits for any renovation that involves structural changes, electrical work, plumbing modifications or changes to the building envelope. For townhouse owners, this means permits are required for kitchen reconfigurations that move walls, bathroom expansions, and any work that alters windows or exterior walls. The City of Surrey building permit fee schedule for 2026 ranges from $150 for minor plumbing or electrical permits to $2,500 or more for major structural renovations.

Reno Stars handles all permit applications as part of our project management service. For a typical Surrey townhouse kitchen renovation, our team has obtained permits within 10 to 15 business days for projects in Guildford and Fleetwood, and within 7 to 10 business days for projects in Clayton.

Reno Stars has completed townhouse renovation projects across every major Surrey neighbourhood. In Surrey, we have completed a modern kitchen renovation with custom cabinets featuring a full-overlay door style, a two-bathroom renovation delivering updated plumbing, new ceramic tile work and dual vanities, and a kitchen renovation featuring a waterfall island design in a Langley townhouse that received Strata approval in 14 days.

Frequently Asked Questions About Surrey Townhouse Renovation

Can I renovate my townhouse without Strata approval in Surrey?

No. Under the Strata Property Act (British Columbia), any renovation that affects common property, structural elements, or the exterior of a townhouse unit requires Strata Council approval before work begins. Renovations limited to the interior with no structural, electrical or plumbing changes may not require a permit, but you must still notify your Strata Council. Failure to obtain required approvals can result in fines, mandatory restoration and delays selling your unit.

How long does a townhouse kitchen renovation take in Surrey?

A typical kitchen renovation in a Surrey townhouse — including Strata approval, permit acquisition, demolition, electrical and plumbing upgrades, and finishing work — takes 8 to 14 weeks from initial consultation to final inspection. Cosmetic-only renovations that do not require permit changes can be completed in 3 to 6 weeks. Complex projects involving structural changes or building envelope remediation can take 4 to 6 months.

What is the biggest unexpected cost in Surrey townhouse renovations?

Polybutylene (poly-B) piping replacement is the most common unexpected cost in Surrey townhouses built before 2000. BC building code no longer permits poly-B for potable water supply, and many insurers now require replacement before renewing policies. Replacing poly-B throughout a townhouse unit costs $3,500 to $9,000 depending on the number of bathrooms and the complexity of the existing plumbing layout.

Does renovating my Surrey townhouse increase its assessed value?

According to BC Assessment Authority data for the Fraser Valley region, a well-executed kitchen or bathroom renovation in a townhouse complex can increase assessed value by 5 to 15 percent, depending on the quality of the finishes and the condition of comparable units in the same complex. The strongest returns come from renovations that bring a dated unit in line with current market standards for the neighbourhood.

Does the City of Surrey offer grants for townhouse energy upgrades?

The City of Surrey offers rebates through its Clean BC Energy Coach program and the BC Hydro Energy Conservation programs for eligible energy upgrades including heat pumps, insulation and windows. Townhouse owners should confirm eligibility with the program provider, as some rebate programs apply to the Strata corporation rather than individual unit owners for common-area improvements. Visit the City of Surrey website or speak with a Reno Stars project consultant for current 2026 rebate availability.

2026年素里鎮屋裝修費用為 $25,000 至 $150,000 或更高，具體取決於工程範圍、建築年份及是否為自住或出售做準備。與獨立屋不同，素里的每一個鎮屋裝修都需要 Strata 管委會批准，並符合 BC 建築規範要求 — 這流程會使項目時間表增加兩到八週。本指南基於 Reno Stars 的真實項目數據和素里市建築許可部門的記錄，為屋主提供 2026 年準確的費用預期。

2026 年素里鎮屋裝修費用是多少？

素里鎮屋裝修費用可分為三個層級。美容翻新（新規油漆、地板、照明和櫥櫃五金）通常為 $15,000 至 $35,000。功能性翻新（包括廚房或浴室更新、管道裝置更新和新檯面）通常為 $40,000 至 $85,000。全面拆修（包括拆牆、布線、改管道和升級結構構件）可達 $100,000 至 $150,000 或更高，特別是在 2000 年以前建成、建築圍護結構問題常見的鎮屋小區。

鎮屋小區的建築年齡是最大的成本變量。素里 Cloverdale、Fleetwood 和 Guildford 常見的 1980 和 1990 年代鎮屋，通常需要先進行 poly-B 管道更換、電力配電箱升級和建築圍護結構修復，然後才能開始美容工程。Reno Stars 自 2018 年以來在素里完成了超過 40 個鎮屋裝修項目，項目造價從單浴室翻新的 $22,000 到 Clayton 兩層鎮屋全面拆修的 $138,000 不等。

素里鎮屋裝修的 Strata 審批流程

素里的每個鎮屋均受《BC 省分層財產法》約束，這意味著您的裝修計劃必須在開工前獲得 Strata 管委會批准。審批流程通常需要提交裝修申請，附上詳細圖紙、承包商信息和工程範圍說明。大多數 Strata 管委會需要兩到四週來審查申請，有些還對噪音時間、施工人員出入和公共區域允許的材料類型施加限制。

Reno Stars 已成功辦理素里十多個鎮屋小區的 Strata 審批流程，包括由 Crossroads Strata Management、Bentley Strata Services 和 Baywest Property Management 管理的小區。我們作為標準項目流程的一部分準備所有所需文件，並代表業主與 Strata 管委會直接協調。在建築成本之上，另需預算 $500 至 $1,500 的許可證和申請費用。

規劃廚房、浴室、全屋或商業裝修？立即聯繫 Reno Stars 獲取免費、無義務報價。

素里社區指南：按區域的鎮屋裝修

素里的鎮屋庫存因社區而異，這直接影響裝修範圍和成本。Clayton 和 Willoughby（較新區域）的鎮屋建於 2010 至 2022 年間，採用現代佈局、較大面積，底層問題較少。這些地區的裝修往往側重於美學升級而非結構修復，廚房或浴室翻新的一般項目成本為 $35,000 至 $95,000。

Fleetwood 和 Guildford 擁有素里最大規模的 1980 和 1990 年代鎮屋小區。這些單元通常格局陳舊、浴室設施落後，需要在美容工程開始前進行基礎設施更新。例如，在 1992 年建成的 Guildford 鎮屋中，全面廚房翻新不僅需要新櫥櫃和檯面，還需要升級電力配電箱以容納現代電器 — 這將使項目成本增加 $3,000 至 $8,000。

Cloverdale 鎮屋則介於兩者之間。社區的傳統特色延伸至 1970 年代至 2000 年代建成的鎮屋小區，包括自有和租賃混合型 Strata 建築。在自有型小區中，鄰里相識，Strata 審批可能更快；但以租賃為主的建築可能需要更正規的文件和更長的審查期。

  • Clayton/Willoughby：新建建築（2010-2022年），結構問題少，廚房/浴室翻新一般 $35K-$95K
  • Fleetwood/Guildford：1980年代-1990年代庫存，常需電氣或管道修復，全面翻新 $45K-$120K
  • Cloverdale：混合年齡（1970年代-2000年代），自有型小區審批更快，一般項目 $30K-$90K

素里鎮屋裝修需要建築許可證嗎？

素里要求對任何涉及結構改動、電氣工程、管道修改或建築圍護結構變更的裝修頒發建築許可證。對於鎮屋業主，這意味著廚房改建（涉及移動牆壁）、浴室擴建以及任何改動窗戶或外牆的工程都需要許可證。素里市 2026 年建築許可證收費表，小型管道或電氣許可證為 $150，全面結構翻新的費用可達 $2,500 或更高。

Reno Stars 在項目管理服務中代為處理所有許可證申請。對於素里典型的鎮屋廚房翻新項目，我們的團隊在 Guildford 和 Fleetwood 的項目分別在 10 至 15 個工作日內獲得許可，在 Clayton 的項目在 7 至 10 個工作日內獲得許可。

Reno Stars 在素里鎮屋完成的項目

Reno Stars 在素里每個主要社區完成了鎮屋裝修項目。在素里，我們完成了定制櫥櫃現代廚房翻新、升級管道、瓷磚工程和雙洗漱台的兩浴室翻新，以及在 Langley 鎮屋中採用瀑布島設計的廚房翻新，Strata 審批僅用 14 天。

關於素里鎮屋裝修的常見問題

在素里，我可以不經 Strata 批准就裝修鎮屋嗎？

不行。根據《BC 省分層財產法》，任何影響公共財產，結構構件或鎮屋外部的裝修都必須在開工前獲得 Strata 管委會批准。不需要許可證的裝修（僅限於不改變結構、電氣或管道的室內工程）也必須通知 Strata 管委會，未獲得所需批准可能導致罰款、強制恢復原狀，以及出售時的延誤。

素里鎮屋廚房翻新需要多長時間？

素里鎮屋典型廚房翻新（包括 Strata 批准、許可證獲取、拆除、水電升級和收尾工程）從初步諮詢到最終驗收需要 8 至 14 週。不需要許可證更改的美容翻新可在 3 至 6 週內完成。涉及結構改動或建築圍護修復的複雜項目可能需要 4 至 6 個月。

素里鎮屋裝修中最大的意外成本是什麼？

Polybutylene（poly-B）管道更換是 2000 年以前建成的素里鎮屋中最常見的意外成本。BC 建築規範不再允許將 poly-B 用於飲用水供應，許多保險公司現在要求更換後才能續保。在整個鎮屋單元中更換 poly-B 的費用為 $3,500 至 $9,000，具體取決於浴室數量和現有管道佈局的複雜程度。

翻新我的素里鎮屋會增加評估價值嗎？

根據 BC 評估管理局 Fraser Valley 地區的數據，在鎮屋小區中執行良好的廚房或浴室翻新可使評估價值增加 5% 至 15%，具體取決於飾面質量和同一小區中可比單元的狀況。將過時單元升至當前市場標準的翻新通常比在較新小區中的類似升級獲得更高的百分比收益。

素里市是否為鎮屋節能升級提供資助？

素里市通過 Clean BC Energy Coach 計劃和 BC Hydro 節能計劃為合資格的節能升級（包括熱泵、保溫和窗戶）提供回扣。鎮屋業主應向計劃提供商確認資格，因為某些回扣計劃適用於 Strata 法人團體而非單個業主的公共區域改善工程。請訪問素里市政府網站或聯繫 Reno Stars 項目顧問，了解當前 2026 年的回扣資訊。
